statements.text: SELECT id, records_meta FROM pipeline_runs WHERE pipeline = ANY($1::text[]) AND status = ANY($2::text[]) AND NOT COALESCE(records_meta->'audit_table'->'rows' @> '[{"metric":"write_skipped_pre_write_warn"}]'::jsonb, false) ORDER BY started_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $3

UPDATE pipeline_runs
       SET completed_at = NOW(), status = $1, duration_ms = $2, error_message = $3,
           records_total = $5,
           records_new = $6,
           records_updated = $7,
           records_meta = COALESCE($8::jsonb, records_meta)
       WHERE id = $4
